findings: Chart values lack an accessible all-month table
No concise result announcement after control changes
Keyboard outline has 2.505:1 contrast against white
changes: Expandable semantic table for every held-out month; selected month marked; descriptive caption and focusable horizontal-scroll region
Concise polite result status and hindsight warning; checkbox linked to its explanation
Solid target and dashed forecast distinguish chart series independently of colour
Dark-blue keyboard outline with increased contrast
numeric_reproduction: Published model coefficients, 54 forecasts, metrics and paired interval pass; no fresh raw-document audit claimed.
scope: Local source, exact embedded app, DOM model and numeric/build controls. Native browser, viewport and assistive-technology observations are separate; no screen-reader or universal accessibility certification.
